analytics.title: HR analytics
analytics.subtitle: Headcount, joiners and leavers, absence and lateness, overtime, leave taken, licences running out and hiring — for the period and department picked.

kpiDef.headcount: Employees on the books on the last day of the period (joined, and not past their last working day).
kpiDef.joiners: Employees whose joining date falls in the period.
kpiDef.leavers: Employees whose last working day falls in the period (and is past).
kpiDef.attrition: Leavers ÷ the average of the headcount at the start and the end of the period. Annualised: scaled to a year.
kpiDef.absenteeism: Days marked absent ÷ days people were due at work (present, half day, absent or on leave), from the computed attendance.
kpiDef.late: Days with a late arrival (past the grace minutes in Settings) ÷ days present.
kpiDef.overtime: Minutes worked beyond the shift on every attendance day in the period, in hours.
kpiDef.openPositions: People still to hire on open requisitions (count asked for less those hired).
kpiDef.timeToHire: Average days from adding a candidate to hiring them, for hires in the period.

kpiSub.atStart_one: {{count}} at the start of the period
kpiSub.atStart_other: {{count}} at the start of the period

analytics.absenceLatenessSub: Each day: absent ÷ due at work, late ÷ present
analytics.joinersLeaversSub: Month by month in the period
analytics.leaveTakenSub: Approved days in the period, by type
analytics.licencesSub: Staff on the books, by validity
analytics.nursesPerBedTitle: Nurses per bed, by ward — nurses whose usual ward it is, against its active beds
analytics.wardsEmpty: No wards with beds or nurses
analytics.wardsEmptyHint: Post nurses to their wards on the employee record (Usual wards).
analytics.defNursesText: Current nurses whose usual wards include the ward (Employees › Usual wards) against the ward’s active beds.
analytics.defLicencesText: Licences and certificates with a validity date, of people on the books, by how soon they run out from today.
